Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production animation sprite sheet, transparent PNG, for the Java top-down 2D RPG "용사가 다한다".
Edit/reference input: the provided single front-facing hero is the EXACT approved character and the APPROVED detail density. Preserve its face, swept brown hair silhouette, red scarf, navy tunic with cream trim and rolled sleeves, diagonal brown strap, simple brass buckle, dark fingerless gloves, dark trousers and brown boots. The user explicitly prefers this richer reference over a heavily simplified tiny sprite. Do not reduce the character into a crude small icon. No more ornate texture than reference, no 3D rendering or smooth material realism.
Primary request: expand this exact hero into a coherent SIX-FRAME animation sheet. Keep bold clean pixel-art-looking square color clusters and the reference's amount of detail. Same head-to-body ratio, colors, hairstyle, body scale, cloth thickness, outline thickness and lighting in all six frames. All hands empty, no sword in the sheet.
CANVAS AND FRAME LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024, exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, each cell 512x512. TRANSPARENT gutters/background. No gridlines, text, labels, cast shadows, ground, glows or decorations. One fully isolated entire character per cell, never crossing cell boundaries.
TOP ROW: front-facing idle; back-facing idle; right-facing idle.
BOTTOM ROW: front-facing walking step; back-facing walking step; right-facing walking step.
Alignment: body center x=256 within EVERY cell; boots touch baseline y=468 within EVERY cell. Same character height about 416 px, same head width about 155 px in every cell. At least 40 transparent pixels around each frame. Scarf tail short enough to remain inside cell. Ground plane and perspective consistent with slight top-down camera.
Walking: subtle single walking step, one foot slightly forward and one slightly back, opposite arm motion. No jumping, no extreme lunges, no leaning, no attack, no enlarged foreshortening. Torso and head remain same size and aligned with corresponding idle frame. Keep feet near the SAME baseline, never make walking character bigger.
Maintain recognizable face with large readable eyes, distinct brown hair locks, scarf folds in a few broad red planes, flat navy panels, cream cuffs, and clear brown boot silhouettes. Do not create fine texture, micro hair strands, shiny metal bevels, bloom, dithering or painterly brushwork.
Keep all surrounding pixels truly alpha=0; opaque character pixels. Transparent background required.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: game smithing animation sprite sheet. Expand the exact hero in input 1 into SIX smithing poses on transparent background. Keep brown spiky hair, red scarf, navy cream-trim tunic, leather belt and brown boots, short heroic proportions. Match input's coarse pixel-shaped clusters and restrained flat 3-tone shading EXACTLY, no painterly 3D highlights. Canvas 1536x1024, 3 columns x 2 rows, 512x512 cells. Every pose faces RIGHT in side/three-quarter view; body center x=220 within cell, feet baseline y=474. Body from head to foot ~350px tall leaving room for raised hammer. Top row left to right: resting holding a short forging hammer down; hammer raised above head preparing strike; leaning forward bringing hammer down at waist height to the RIGHT (hammer head x~405 y~325). Bottom row left to right: recoiling after strike; pleased success pose head lifted and small fist raised, hammer lowered; disappointed failed pose head bowed, shoulders slumped, hammer lowered. Fixed outfit, scale, feet baseline and direction across all six. Only hero and held hammer; NO anvil, NO sword, NO ground/shadow, NO sparks or background. Ample transparent gutters between cells. No text, labels, grid or borders. Actual alpha transparency.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: gameplay enemy atlas. Redraw input 1's SEVEN enemy identities in the flatter coarse pixel-cluster style of input 2 hero. Keep recognizable silhouettes and color identities, but strip tiny texture, realistic bevels and excessive ornamentation. Attractive readable detailed pixel-style 2D RPG art with about 3 shade groups per material, no glossy rendering. One transparent 1536x1024 sheet, 4 columns x 2 rows, each cell 384x512. Completely contain each sprite inside its own cell with 24px gutters. Top row: purple wide-winged bat; ivory skeleton with rusty shield and sword; red horned imp; bulky gray stone golem with cyan crystal core. Bottom row: dark armored red-plumed knight with shield and sword; bulky purple hooded horned warden with gold trim; black-purple horned demon lord with crown and purple blade; EMPTY last cell. Standing figures face forward three-quarter, feet on common y=470 baseline in their cell. No cast shadows, no external glow, no backgrounds, no labels or borders. Transparent alpha.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: gameplay prop atlas. Restyle input 1's six props to match input 2 hero: deliberate chunky pixel-shaped clusters, flat 2D overhead RPG perspective, restrained palette and 3-tone shading, clear silhouettes. Less texture and less 3D realism. Canvas 1536x1024, 3x2 equal 512x512 cells with transparent gutters. Row 1: compact stone smithy furnace with chimney, orange fire and a gray anvil on stump clearly separated at front right; khaki canvas bedroll with cream pillow and brown straps; small campfire inside ring of stones. Row 2: blue-gray blackiron ore boulder; dark red bloodmoon crystal ore boulder; pale cyan sky crystal ore boulder. Preserve identities and readable forms. All complete, no cropping, no cast shadows beyond objects, no bloom or translucent haze. Actual transparent alpha background, no labels/grid/borders.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: game tile material atlas. Replace input 1's ornate semi-3D textures with calm flat 2D pixel-style dungeon surfaces matching input 2's bold blocky shading. Exact 4 columns x 2 rows of square texture panels, edge-to-edge, NO gutters/borders/text. Landscape 2048x1024 canvas. Upper row FLOOR materials in order: muted warm brown camp cobbles with sparse moss; blue gray mine stone paving; desaturated dark brick-red castle floor; muted dusky purple tower flagstones. Lower row corresponding WALL materials: brown-gray stacked stones; blue-gray rough mine rocks; brick-red castle masonry; purple stone blocks. Low contrast sparse cracks, broad flat color clusters, no noisy speckle or tiny decorative etching, no glowing gold cracks, no vegetation sticking out, no objects, no perspective or height rendering. Each panel tileable at its own boundaries. Entirely opaque. Readable as quiet background under hero/enemies.
